candidate_ideas.statement: Even boundary-detection lemma: if 2g-2+n>0 and m is even with m≤2g+n-2, then the simultaneous one-edge clutching kernel P_{g,n}^m:=⋂_Γ ker(ξ_Γ^*:H^m(overline{M}_{g,n};Q)→H^m(∏_v overline{M}_{g_v,n_v};Q)) is a finite direct sum of Q(-m/2).

The augmented ordered stable-arc complex, with generators stable graphs cut along ordered arcs and decorated by Künneth factors of vertex cohomology, resolves the simultaneous one-edge boundary-restriction kernels defining P_{g,n}^m.

There is a chain homotopy h on the Künneth-decorated ordered stable-arc complex, given by flag-ordered insertion of an admissible arc at the active vertex, such that after quotienting by the full Tate subcategory one has dh+hd=id except on terminal genus-one vertices.

Non-Tate primitive cohomology at a terminal genus-one vertex with a incident flags is identified via the two-term resolution over M_{1,1} and Eichler–Shimura with parabolic cohomology of Sym^{a-1}H, first occurs for a=11, and lies in odd cohomological degree (and remains odd after Tate twists).

For even m<22 in the range of the augmented kernel, the non-Tate part of the degree-zero homology of the ordered stable-arc complex vanishes; in particular it vanishes for every even m≤16, so P_{g,n}^m is Tate.
P_{6,6}^{16} is a finite direct sum of Q(-8).
The proper-pair kernel K=ker(H^{16}(overline{M}_{6,6};Q)→H^{16}(D;Q)) is a finite direct sum of Q(-8).
W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a finite direct sum of Q(8).
Semisimplicity upgrades a genuine non-Tate vanishing (or pure Tate-ness) of P^{16}_{6,6} to pure Tate-ness of every subobject, including K.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0001 (mechanically_verified for all cases).
established_facts.statement: For d=3g-3+n, the open graded piece W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n};Q) is identified by Poincaré duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n};Q)(d).

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0001 together with the duality form used for the exact target.
established_facts.statement: For a smooth complex Deligne–Mumford stack X of dimension d, Poincaré duality of mixed Hodge structures gives H_k^{BM}(X;Q) ≅ H^{2d-k}(X;Q)(d).

established_facts.evidence: Arithmetic from d=3g-3+n and the Poincaré duality reindexing of FND-0001; the Tate twist (21) shifts weights by -42.
Same-degree BM/compact-support duality of MHS and dual of pure Tate type Q(-8).
established_facts.statement: Borel–Moore homology is dual to compactly supported cohomology in the same degree with no extra Tate twist, so W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(X;Q) ≅ (Gr^W_{16}H_c^{16}(X;Q))^∨; the dual of Q(-8) is Q(8).

established_facts.evidence: Exactness of the proper-pair localization sequence of MHS plus strictness of the weight filtration under Deligne weight bounds for proper and smooth sources.
established_facts.statement: For X=M_{g,n} smooth, Y=overline{M}_{g,n} smooth proper, D=Y\X proper, and coefficients Q, the localization sequence H^{m-1}(D)→H_c^m(X)→H^m(Y)→H^m(D) is exact in MHS; Deligne weight bounds give weights on H^{m-1}(D)≤m-1, H^m(Y) pure of weight m, and weights on H_c^m(X)≤m, hence Gr^W_m H_c^m(X;Q) ≅ ker(H^m(Y;Q)→H^m(D;Q)) as a pure polarizable Hodge structure of weight m.

established_facts.evidence: Specialization of the proper-pair weight-strict localization identity at m=16.
established_facts.statement: In particular for (g,n,m)=(6,6,16), Gr^W_{16}H_c^{16}(M_{6,6};Q) ≅ K:=ker(H^{16}(overline{M}_{6,6};Q)→H^{16}(D;Q)) as pure polarizable HS of weight 16.

established_facts.evidence: Factorization of one-edge clutching morphisms through the boundary divisor D, hence vanishing on D implies vanishing under every one-edge pullback.
established_facts.statement: If P is the simultaneous kernel of all one-edge clutching pullbacks ξ_Γ^* on H^{16}(overline{M}_{6,6};Q), then K ⊆ P, because each one-edge clutching factors through D (finite quotients of clutching sources onto boundary components).

established_facts.evidence: Semisimplicity of the abelian category of pure polarizable rational Hodge structures of fixed weight.
established_facts.statement: Pure polarizable rational Hodge structures are semisimple, so every subobject of a finite direct sum of Q(-m/2) is again a finite direct sum of Q(-m/2).

established_facts.statement: For g=6 and the f_2=5 summand, deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1})=6.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0020 (corroborated for g=6,n=6).
established_facts.statement: R^1π_*Q for the universal n-punctured curve is mixed of weights 1 and 2 (an extension of a rank n-1 Tate system of weight 2 by the rank 2g weight-1 system), never pure of weight 1; the correct weight floor for H^p(base;L) is therefore ≥p+1.
For the residual list containing (6,6), the ordinary degree 2d-16 equals vcd(M_{6,6}) and never exceeds vcd on that list, so vanishing-above-vcd alone does not prove the (6,6) case.

established_facts.statement: For the forgetful map M_{6,6}→M_{6,5}, the term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes because 26>vcd(M_{6,5})=25; with fibre cohomology only in degrees 0 and 1, no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.

A chain homotopy on Künneth-decorated generators of the ordered stable-arc complex with a verified identity dh+hd=id (including signs from graph automorphisms and cancellation of unstable outputs under stabilization).
Control of non-Tate summands supported on genus ≥2 vertices that already lie in a vertex-level restriction kernel and are fixed as terminals by any pullback-based insertion operator.
A precise duality/reindexing relating degree-preserving clutching pullbacks to Gysin/node-shift complexes, if Gysin bookkeeping is to be used for conclusions about P.

Eichler–Shimura identification of terminal genus-one non-Tate primitives (first occurrence at a=11, odd degree, parity after Tate twists) in full local-system precision, once the arc model is shown to compute P.
Proof that P_{6,6}^{16} is pure Tate of type Q(-8), and thence—via K⊆P and semisimplicity—that K is pure Tate of type Q(-8).
Assembly of the proper-pair identification Gr^W_{16}H_c^{16}≅K with Tate-ness of K and BM/Poincaré dualities to conclude that the exact target is a direct sum of Q(8).
